name: nas-benchmarks
description: A collection of neural architecture search (NAS) benchmarking datasets that provide precomputed training/evaluation results for large architecture search spaces to enable reproducible NAS research and fast evaluation of search algorithms. It measures architecture performance (e.g., classification accuracy) and often includes efficiency metrics (FLOPs, latency) across standard datasets. The benchmark is used to compare NAS algorithms and performance-prediction methods without costly re-training.
evaluation_method: classification accuracy (top-1/top-5) and efficiency metrics such as FLOPs or latency
general_score_metric: top-1 classification accuracy (with secondary metrics of FLOPs/latency)
typical_sota_score: dataset-dependent; often high for small vision datasets (e.g., ≈90–99% top-1 on some CIFAR variants) — varies by dataset and metric
reputation: Widely used in the NAS research community as a standard reproducible evaluation suite for comparing architecture search methods.
